channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Nvidia share buyback plan gets $150 billion boost
item.description: Nvidia said the buyback boost marks the largest share repurchase authorization increase in history.

item.title: SpaceX launches its massive Starship rocket into orbit for the first time
item.description: Elon Musk's SpaceX launched a historic test flight of its massive Starship rocket early Monday.

item.title: Trump to announce plan for $15 billion steel plant, would be largest in U.S. history
item.description: Trump's announcement with Mesabi Metallics comes as Americans' souring views of the economy are poised to shape the upcoming midterm election.

item.title: Stocks fall to start the week as Treasury yields rise once again: Live updates
item.description: Stocks fell Monday, weighed down by a jump in oil prices and Treasury yields to start the week.

item.title: Meta hires MongoDB CEO CJ Desai to lead enterprise unit. MongoDB shares crater
item.description: Desai will lead the new Meta Enterprise Platform unit and report to CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

item.title: 'Take or pay': AI companies are taking a risky page from the energy sector's playbook
item.description: Borrowed from the energy sector, take-or-pay contracts have a firm start date and make customers pay for products regardless of whether they use them.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent hires Wall Street economist David Zervos
item.description: Zervos is joining the Treasury Department as counselor to Bessent, adding a prominent markets voice to the administration's economic policy team.

item.title: Ex-Disney CEO Bob Chapek says he raised concerns with the board 'weekly' during Iger power battle
item.description: Former Disney CEO Bob Chapek was ousted from his role as CEO in late 2022, less than three years after taking the post, and replaced by Iger.

item.title: Trump ‘very seriously’ considering diesel export ban as global supply crunch worsens
item.description: Analysts warn an export ban could backfire, pushing up global diesel prices and potentially triggering higher U.S. gasoline prices as refiners adjust.

item.title: Muse AI agent led Meta Platforms into the Best Stocks in the Market list. What Josh Brown thinks
item.description: Meta made it into Josh Brown's list after last week's surge.

item.title: Many homeowners have a big insurance coverage gap — and don't even know it
item.description: Many consumers have a gap in their homeowners insurance coverage. This puts them at financial risk, and they are likely unaware, experts said.

item.title: Meta's Muse agent is attacking one of the economy's most profitable weak spots
item.description: Meta's Muse AI personal agent will work over your credit card spending if you don't mind the invasion. How big a threat is it to the subscription economy?

item.title: Five arrested over alleged bomb plot at UK air base used by U.S.; Iran denies link
item.description: U.K. counterterrorism police are understood to be investigating a potential link with Iran after an alleged bomb threat against an air base hosting U.S. forces.

item.title: Treasury yields edge higher amid pressure on global government bonds
item.description: Treasury yields edged higher on Monday as investors look ahead to fresh economic data releases this week.

item.title: Oil prices rise as Trump rejects Iranian proposal to reopen Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Oil prices jumped on Monday after U.S. President Donald Trump rejected an Iranian peace proposal aimed at ending the conflict.

item.title: Which 10-year yield level will really start to hit stocks? Here's what history suggests
item.description: The record suggests that the 10-year yield will have to approach 7% in order to meaningfully hurt stocks, according to Bank of America.

item.title: Meta, Google, Amazon, Microsoft draw Sen. Warren questions about AI tax subsidies
item.description: Sen. Elizabeth Warren is asking the leaders of Meta, Google, Amazon and Microsoft about AI and data center subsidies authorized by GOP legislation.

item.title: U.S. finalizes new lower fuel economy standards in boost for gas-powered vehicles
item.description: The Trump administration's new fuel economy standards are expected to cut the cost of new vehicles but increase fuel consumption and carbon dioxide emissions.

item.title: New grads say employers set the bar too high for entry-level roles: 'No job is willing to give you that first experience'
item.description: 77% of new grads believe businesses call for too much experience when hiring for entry-level jobs, shutting them out of an increasingly competitive market.

item.title: Taxpayer-funded Trump ads draw bipartisan scrutiny ahead of midterms
item.description: TV ads featuring Trump are expanding nationally, prompting bipartisan questions over whether they comply with restrictions on taxpayer-funded publicity.

item.title: Jim Cramer says Nvidia’s record buyback could ‘change the trajectory’ of the stock
item.description: Nvidia's $150 billion worth of additional buyback firepower is a major step in the right direction.

item.title: Reverse mortgage vs. annuity: Which is the best for retirement?
item.description: Reverse mortgages can help homeowners tap their equity for retirement, while annuities guarantee income. Here's what you need to know about each.

item.title: 'Funflation' is on the rise as hobbies get pricier, but consumers keep spending anyway
item.description: Consumers are spending more on hobbies like arts and crafts and outdoor sports, as it gets more expensive to travel due to increased airfare.

item.title: U.S., China to lower tariffs on $60 billion of goods. Here's what qualifies
item.description: The lists included U.S. imports of toys, sports equipment and Christmas decorations, while U.S. farm products appeared on the list of Chinese imports.

item.title: At NFL games this season, drone defense tech aims to bring down disruptions
item.description: The NFL told CNBC it recorded 10,852 drone violations over stadiums between 2021 and 2025. The Jaguars became the first team to sign a drone defense firm.

item.title: Apple faces $5.7 billion patent infringement verdict over iPhone and Apple Watch haptics
item.description: A federal jury awarded Taction Technology more than $5.7 billion after finding Apple infringed claims from two haptics patents. Apple plans to appeal.

item.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei set to meet with Trump after missing state dinner
item.description: As top tech CEOs rubbed elbows at President Trump's glitzy dinner for Chinese President Xi on Thursday, Anthropic's CEO was noticeably absent.

item.title: Supply glut, lab-grown alternatives: What's behind the fall of diamond prices to record lows
item.description: Natural 1-carat asking prices are down sharply from 2021 as oversupply and cheaper lab-grown diamonds reshape the jewelry market.

item.title: Whole Foods co-founder shares tips for launching a successful second act: 'I'm relearning some lessons'
item.description: John Mackey is learning that what helped him build Whole Foods Market into a multibillion-dollar business can help him in his second act, but only if he's patient.

item.title: Wall Street money takes back over from small investors as driving force of the stock market
item.description: One firm sees a "reasonably constructive signal for risk appetite" among institutional investors.
